decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis app was launched as a new product line with a page of its own, and digitalization demand in dental practices is rising, so the option is still valuable and cheap to keep alongside the core practice software.
The continuing education institute fits the firm's dental customer base and costs little to maintain, but its value is still uncertain, so management keeps the option open.
The remote screen sharing tool is a low-cost support utility embedded in customer service, and it gained value during remote-work years, so there is little reason to abandon it.
The analytics dashboard builds on existing practice data and adds upsell value, and its prospects are not yet resolved, so keeping it costs little.
The complete practice bundle mainly repackages existing products, so it is cheap to keep, though it could be reorganized into other offers.

The job and practice listing portal lies furthest from the core software business and faces strong competing platforms, making it the weakest option, but its low maintenance cost justifies keeping it a while longer.
